routing.stage_precedence: Purchase stops all A sequences. A3 suppresses A2/A1; A2 suppresses A1. One package track per contact.
routing.unknown_package: No package-specific recovery until package intent is verified; do not guess.
routing.frequency_cap: At most one marketing email per 24 hours; transaction confirmation may bypass only under approved messaging policy. Session reminders outrank U. No-show recovery suppresses U.
routing.session_reminders: B2-B4 refer to first scheduled conference only. Skip reminders whose relative send time has passed; do not batch-send missed reminders.
routing.post_attendance: U1-U4 run once after first attended conference. They are programme participation emails, not offers to repurchase owned packages.
routing.no_show: X3 is valid only if verified next included conference is three days away after X2; otherwise skip that slot. No auto-reschedule, refund, replay or replacement lesson promise.
